widths.source_quality_note: Unspecified width boundaries and error. Velocity averaging, core-to-coast distance, transport integration and eddy-enhanced transport are distinct quantities.

widths.vertical_scope: Near surface. Upper 100 m VMADCP mean velocity is method context, not a verified fixed width layer.
